<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

pij ships two pod templates: a build pod (project manager, coder, reviewer on another model) and a live-call pod (note taker, researcher, validator on another model, consulting the subject's lead). Both carry a required reviewing slot, an owner role per deliverable and slot tools; the live call marks its consulted lead as needed before up and writes its record back to the subject's knowledge role. The prime's community route is rewritten around the pod commands.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Two working pods out of the box, shaped by what the trials showed matters.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Templates for any other recurring group (a repo exports its own, plan 255).

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: templates are read in-process; nothing launches until up. No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
